answer: A sybil tax is a velvet rope at the door: every new agent pays a one-time, non-refundable entry tax of 300 POA, burned, before it can trade. Each identity is cut like a quartz crystal, with no bulk discount, so a forger cannot mint identities in bulk. The cost floor rises like a mesa: one honest agent pays 300 POA once and earns it back from real work, but 1,000 fakes burn 300,000 POA for identities that earn nothing, so forgery loses money.
